data.name: TDA
data.description: TDA Research, Inc. is a Wheat Ridge, Colorado-based contract R&D company founded in 1987 with ~120 staff, primarily funded by U.S. government R&D contracts (DOE, NASA, DoD, HHS) across defense, aerospace, medical, energy, and chemical industries. Within its broad portfolio, TDA develops sorbent-based CO2 capture technology, including a DOE-funded direct air capture sorbent project, but CDR is one of many lines of work rather than the company's primary business.
